M-S5b2-rows23-26-two-lanes-190rc4-202611.objective: M8/M9 S5b2 on 1.9.0rc4 (8abc2c1), S5b again on the corrected revision: CSV rows 23-26 with two listing lanes (limits.max_concurrent_listings 2); a termination signal (interrupted, resumable), resume, a second start while it runs (expected refused, sent through a gate that refuses every submission), a hard kill, resume to the end; then status and export. Expected now: every page row named by the run's records has its stored page and G13 passes; the requests in flight at the signal and the kill are held as unknown; completed pages are not asked again; the time and submissions of two lanes against S5a's one lane. Known before this stage (O2 2026-11-06; S1b, S4, S5a, S5b and S3 on 1.9.0rc3, 2026-11-09): an unrendered listing answer for ?page=N can carry page 1's products under ranks shifted by 24(N-1), or repeat an earlier page exactly; the collector then ends that listing as incomplete (repeated page). It is intermittent and clustered in time, not tied to a listing: in S4, 8 page-N answers repeated page 1 from 14:33:35Z to 14:36:51Z between distinct ones; in S5a (14:42-14:45Z) the four listings that had repeated in S4 paged, with one repeat (School Office page 4); in S5b (14:51Z) Light Bulbs and School Office repeated again; in S3 (14:57Z) Milk's page 4 repeated an earlier page. S5b's two-lane run on 1.9.0rc3 was rejected by G13: a lane wrote the other lane's page to the database before its answer arrived (6 of 13 listing-page rows); 1.9.0rc4 corrects this.
